items.summary: Published the first source-pinned shortlist: visual direction, UI review, and React or Next.js performance, with explicit limits and no performance ranking.
Added source-pinned React skills for component architecture and meaningful interface motion; surfaced a reported Composition Patterns example issue without calling it pool verification.
Added an adoption gate after task fit: target agent, project or global scope, source revision, local edits, and upstream-update review. Rechecked the existing Anthropic and Vercel source pins.

Added OpenAI Frontend App Builder as a conditional sixth task lane for new visual surfaces that can use an Image Gen concept, approval, browser verification, and image comparison. Rechecked the existing Anthropic and Vercel source pins.

Added OpenAI Product Design Audit as a conditional seventh task lane for a real product flow that can be captured and inspected. Separated rendered-flow audit from source-file UI review and named the screenshot evidence limit.
Added Vercel Agent Browser 0.38.1 as a conditional eighth task lane for navigating and retaining runnable UI states. Separated capture evidence from a design or accessibility verdict.
